title: RSWS core acquisition model
scope: Week 5 p.17–20 core acquisition/payment; association lines are not temporal arrows
assumptions: Cash retains ResourceType as p.17–20; other lecture patterns use Resource CashAccount. Do not normalize this source conflict silently.
No transaction amounts supplied by original RSWS; allocation fields are schema, not observed transactions.
Internal role classes do not prove separate natural persons. Supplier scope and overhead-only purchases require explicit business interpretation.
